title: Input sources, version 2
description: Upstream projects pinned at an immutable revision and the files selected from them. Each input is identified as `<source>:<path>` and is acquired only if its bytes match the declared SHA-256 and byte size.

selection.description: How the inputs were selected. `failure_enriched` inputs were chosen for the defects and edge cases they hold, so a rate computed over them is not a compatibility rate; `stratified` inputs were drawn from a stated pool of candidates by a quota per stratum, so a rate holds for one stratum of that pool, not for the pool as a whole nor for PDFs in general; `representative` inputs were chosen to stand for the documents found in practice.

file_url.description: Template of the download URL of one file at the pinned revision. `{revision}` is replaced by the revision value and `{path}` by the URL-encoded input path.

strata.description: Every stratum the input belongs to, recorded from its bytes at the pinned revision. Strata overlap, so an input usually belongs to several.

oneOf.description: Cross-reference table whose trailer points to a cross-reference stream (`/XRefStm`)
No usable cross-reference section; a reader has to rebuild it
At least one signature dictionary with a `/ByteRange`
qpdf reports the file as damaged, an invalid cross-reference entry or stream, or cannot recognize its header
An interactive form with at least one field that is not a signature field
A header declaring a PDF version below 1.3
At least the byte size or the page count that the selection plan sets as large
A document timestamp (`/ETSI.RFC3161`) or a signature carrying a signature timestamp token
A document security store (`/DSS`) or a signature carrying non-empty Adobe revocation information
